'''FC Rustavi''' (''[[Georgian language|Georgian]]'': საფეხბურთო კლუბი რუსთავი) is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] football club based in the city of [[Rustavi]]. Following the [[2025 Erovnuli Liga 2|2025 season]], they were promoted to the top tier of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]].

Founded in 2015, it is one of the youngest participants of the Georgian football leagues.

The team has spent two seasons in the top division."}}
